summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Growth Copilot MVP. File uploads and anomaly detection work correctly, but AI analysis endpoint has a critical bug preventing the core AI workflow from functioning.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 500 error with '404: Anomaly not found' when trying to analyze valid anomaly IDs
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks entire AI analysis workflow - users cannot get AI insights
critical_bugs.details: Anomaly IDs exist in /api/metrics but cannot be found in analyze endpoint. Likely database query issue in find_one operation.

integration_issues.issue: Analyze buttons trigger backend error, but frontend shows proper error toast messages

passed_tests: File upload UI components display correctly
Metric cards display with correct data (4 anomalies detected)
Metric anomaly detection from Mixpanel CSV (>5% changes)
All file upload endpoints (Mixpanel CSV, MoEngage JSON, Jira CSV)
Error handling with user-friendly toast messages
Backend API connectivity and health check
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical backend bug in /api/analyze/{anomaly_id} endpoint. The endpoint cannot find anomaly records by ID despite them existing in the database. Check the database query logic in the analyze_metric function around line 265 in server.py. This blocks the entire AI analysis workflow which is core to the MVP functionality.

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (All UI components work, error handling good, dependent on backend fix)
